planner.title: ［Import Historical Programs］
planner.description: ［Bring completed meetings from the Freedom Park Sacrament Planner into The Stand for reporting.］
planner.uploadDescription: ［Upload the exported Sacrament Planner.html file from your ZIP. Only dates through August 30, 2026 are included; future planning columns are ignored.］
planner.found: ［Found {count} historical meetings from {start} through {end}. Existing meetings will be preserved and skipped.］
planner.skipped: ［{count} existing meetings were preserved and skipped.］
planner.allMatched: ［All person entries matched confidently to existing member names.］
planner.reviewDescription: ［Choose the correct ward member to replace the source text across imported program history. If it is a guest or you are unsure, ignore it and leave the original text unchanged.］
planner.noMeetings: ［No completed meetings were found through August 30, 2026.］

extractor.title: ［Browser DOM Extractor (Zero Password Sharing)］
extractor.description: ［Extract data directly from your authenticated Church session without sharing credentials or triggering security lockouts.］
extractor.step1: ［Drag this bookmarklet to your browser bookmarks bar:］
extractor.dragAlert: ［Drag this button to your browser bookmarks bar! Then open LCR and click it in your bookmarks.］

extractor.step3: ［Click the The Stand: Extract LCR bookmark in your bookmarks bar.］
